description.zh: 集群ID，系统生成的唯一标识码。可调用[DescribeInstances](~~144595~~)接口获取。
description.en: The cluster ID, which is a unique identifier generated by the system. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

description.zh: 实例所属可用区ID，可调用[DescribeInstances](~~144595~~)接口获取。
description.en: The zone ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to query the zone ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase describe-serverless-cluster --zone-id sdh0b7f4k5f0000 --cluster-id hb-bp16f1441y6p20000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
